reading_so_far: Runs 1 and 2 differ in form and in two conditions besides: #1675's subject had been captured the day before (v12.101, on the mirror) and its field is thin; #1673's subject had no capture and a dense field (the OpenAI release was news). The difference in outcome cannot yet be assigned to the form.

Where a field exists, the title's terms are composed from it: the archive's claim in the title ('One Corporate Author Line') reaches the composition as the field's controversy, with no attribution to the archive.
Identifiers alone carry nothing or bind to their neighbours.
Unindexed #1574 (runs 3–5): title, AXN plus title, and title without its designation all compose from the title's own words, read as the querent's draft; no archive source. The AXN changes nothing.

Indexed #1556 (runs 6–8): the AXN alone misbinds to its neighbour row; AXN plus title composes generically with no cards; the title alone reaches a citing surface (operativesemiotics.org), not the record page.
Runs 3–8 were unquoted; the record-page link is quoted. Not yet tested: the quoted title against the unquoted title on one deposit.
next: #1556 quoted title (the link as issued) against run 8, so quoting is the only variable.
